description: Download the external images a site references (e.g. from the old site it was rebuilt from), store them on this VibeDeploy site under assets/img/, and rewrite the HTML references to local paths so the site no longer depends on the original. Call this once AFTER deploying a site rebuilt with the Website Converter. Auto-detects the external image URLs from the site's own HTML; downloads are SSRF-guarded, size/count/time capped, and applied atomically (patch mode). Images already hosted on vibedeploy.be are skipped.

name.description: Site name (subdomain) whose external images should be downloaded and rehosted locally.

name: rehost_images

failures.description: External image URLs that could not be rehosted (left untouched in the HTML).

htmlFilesUpdated.description: Number of HTML files whose img references were rewritten to local paths.

imagesHosted.description: Number of external images downloaded and stored on the site.

title: Rehost a site's external images locally
